claims.object_text: located in the 15q11-13 region implicated in Angelman syndrome
claims.quote: Angelman syndrome (AS) results from lack of genetic contribution from maternal chromosome 15q11-13. This region encompasses three GABAA receptor subunit genes (beta3, alpha5, and gamma3).
